description: This file contains utility methods for manipulating entity model elements in the Apache OFBiz framework, such as string conversions between database and Java naming conventions, name shortening, and type deduction based on SQL type info.

classes.name: ModelUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for entity model manipulation, name conversion, and type inference within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: upperFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of the input string to upper case.

methods.name: lowerFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of the input string to lower case.

methods.name: dbNameToClassName
methods.description: Converts a database name in uppercase with underscores to a Java class name in CamelCase.

methods.name: dbNameToVarName
methods.description: Converts a database name in uppercase with underscores to a lowerCamelCase Java variable name.

methods.name: javaNameToDbName
methods.description: Converts a Java CamelCase variable name to an uppercase underscore-separated database name.

methods.name: shortenDbName
methods.description: Reduces the length of a database name string by removing vowels and characters per specific rules, respecting segment boundaries.

methods.name: packageToPath
methods.description: Converts a Java package name to a platform-independent file system path.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another string.

methods.name: induceFieldType
methods.description: Infers a field type category based on SQL type name, length, and precision.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedField
methods.description: Checks if a model entity potentially has localization resource for a given field.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedFields
methods.description: Checks if a model entity (or its view) has localization resources for specified fields.
